latest.title: Product structures and decompositions of $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric spaces
latest.abstract: In this paper, we establish the decomposition and product theory of $Γ$-symmetric spaces, where $Γ$ is isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$. These results lead to the local classification of semisimple Riemannian $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric spaces of nontrivial type. Furthermore, we identify notable phenomena specific to $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric spaces: the existence of distinct product structures and that of an example with the trivial infinitesimal isotropy representation.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 建立 Z₂×Z₂ 对称空间的乘积及分解理论，并得到非平凡型半单黎曼情形的局部分类。
latest.breakthrough: 揭示不同乘积结构共存及平凡无穷小各向同性表示等现象。
latest.limitations: 分类是局部且针对指定半单类型，不是所有广义对称空间的全局分类。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
latest.priorityReason: 结构几何价值明确，但与度量极限问题距离较远。
